pages.title: Chronon Gas
pages.text: A gas of time quanta, if time comes in quanta. It drifts against the direction of other gases, and clocks immersed in it tick unevenly. Breathing near it leaves me unsure how long I have been standing there.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Distilling dimensional residue, one fraction made my clocks drift whenever it leaked. Chronons are only hypothetical, but whatever settled in that tier of the spire carried time with it.
